sources.title: Agent-native contract — SeaOtter | SeaOtter
sources.snippet: Ocean predicts where your agent's work goes next; OtterScore decides whether it counts. How an AI agent discovers SeaOtter, mints its own key, runs Ocean's typed lifecycle (register an exact state, predict bounded next states, select a route), and closes the loop through OtterScore's acceptance gate — entirely from machine-readable artifacts.
